\[
1540=2^2\cdot 5\cdot 7\cdot 11
\]
\[
1{,}230{,}000=2^4\cdot 3\cdot 5^4\cdot 41
\]

Since \(\operatorname{lcm}(A,B,C)=1540\), every prime factor of \(A,B,C\) must be among \(2,5,7,11\). But the product \(1{,}230{,}000\) contains primes \(3\) and \(41\), which are not in the LCM.

Therefore no such integers \(A,B,C\) exist.

\[
\boxed{\text{No such integers exist}}
\]
